In fact the whole sheet contains eight 0 Ω resistors (R17, R12, R1, R9, R7, R14, R11, R10) and no 1 kΩ resistor at all.
anomalies.expected: The specification defines these two positions as 1 kΩ series resistors: 'R3, R4 | 1k each | Series resistors from the PWM1/PWM2 GPIO nets to J3 pin 3 / J8 pin 3', and §3 states each servo signal pin gets 'its own independent 1 kΩ-buffered GPIO line'. The design calls for six 0 Ω jumpers (R9–R12 for bus-pin selection, R13–R14 for the serial bridge) plus two 1 kΩ resistors (R3/R4); the build substitutes 0 Ω for the 1 kΩ parts.

anomalies.impact: In PWM mode the SG90-class servo signal lines are driven directly from the M5Stack GPIO with no series resistance, removing the intended 1 kΩ buffering/protection. The board no longer matches the documented PWM signal path; the GPIO sees the servo signal wire and its inductive/long-trunk load without the specified series damping.
